title: Stripe wants to own the toll booth between AI models, for ~$10bn
summary: Stripe, valued at $159 billion, wants to own that toll booth as it pushes beyond payments into AI infrastructure . The two already work together, as OpenRouter uses Stripe to bill its own customers.
